name: timer
title: Timer
description: Background timers with a note, an alarm, presets, and music while they run.
author: HarshNarayanJha

commands.name: index
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.description: Start a timer, pick a preset, and choose the music that plays while it runs.

preferences.name: soundRepeat
preferences.title: Sound Repeat
preferences.description: How many times to play the timer sound

preferences.name: musicVolume
preferences.title: Music Volume
preferences.description: mpv volume while the music plays, 0 to 100.

preferences.name: noteFile
preferences.title: Note File
preferences.description: Markdown note holding the timetable. A file, or a directory for a daily note named YYYY-MM-DD.md. Empty hides the tasks.

preferences.name: taskMinutes
preferences.title: Task Length
preferences.description: How long a task from the timetable runs, in minutes.

preferences.name: timetableHeader
preferences.title: Timetable Heading
preferences.description: Heading that starts the timetable section in the note.
